prompt: Where is the quarterly budget meeting being held?
options: Yes, it was held last week.
In the conference room on the fifth floor.
explain: Hỏi Where → trả lời địa điểm "in the conference room". Bẫy: "Yes" không trả lời câu hỏi WH; "budget" lặp từ nhưng nói về nội dung.

prompt: When will the new printer be delivered?
explain: Hỏi When → "Thursday morning" là thời gian. Bẫy: "The printer in the lobby" lặp từ printer và trả lời Where/Which.

prompt: Who's in charge of ordering office supplies?
explain: Hỏi Who → nêu người "Ms. Patel". Bẫy: "pens and paper" trả lời What; "Yes" không dùng cho câu hỏi WH.

prompt: Why was the flight to Singapore delayed?
explain: Hỏi Why → nêu lý do "Because of a mechanical problem". Bẫy: "two hours ago" trả lời When, "Gate fourteen" trả lời Where.

prompt: How did the client presentation go?
explain: "How did ... go?" hỏi kết quả → "Better than we expected". Bẫy: "By taxi" hiểu nhầm How là phương tiện; "presented" lặp âm với presentation.

prompt: Have you finished reviewing the contract?
options: I'm still working on the last section.
Yes, I'll review it next month.
explain: Trả lời gián tiếp "still working on the last section" = chưa xong. Bẫy: "contractor" gần âm contract; "Yes ... next month" mâu thuẫn thì.

prompt: Would you like to meet on Tuesday or Wednesday?
explain: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → "Either day works for me" (ngày nào cũng được). Bẫy: "Yes" không hợp câu hỏi A or B; "met last Tuesday" sai thì, lặp từ.

prompt: Didn't Mr. Kim already approve the travel request?
options: Not yet—he's been out all week.
explain: Câu hỏi phủ định → "Not yet" kèm lý do "he's been out all week". Bẫy: "ticket", "travels" chỉ liên tưởng/lặp từ travel.

prompt: Why don't we order lunch for the training session?
options: That's a good idea—I'll call the caterer.
explain: "Why don't we..." là lời đề nghị → đồng ý "That's a good idea". Bẫy: "Because" hiểu nhầm là câu hỏi lý do; "trained" lặp từ training.

prompt: Could you send me the updated sales figures?
options: Sure, I'll e-mail them right after this call.
explain: Lời yêu cầu → "Sure, I'll e-mail them". Bẫy: "Sales" lặp từ; "He sent it" sai chủ ngữ và lặp từ send.

prompt: The elevator on the east side is out of order again.
explain: Câu trần thuật về thang máy hỏng → phản hồi hợp lý "Let's use the stairs". Bẫy: lặp "elevator" và "order" nhưng sai nghĩa.

prompt: You've worked with this supplier before, haven't you?
explain: Câu hỏi đuôi → "Yes, for about three years". Bẫy: "supply" gần âm supplier; "work late" lặp từ work nhưng sai ý.

prompt: What time does the shuttle to the airport leave?
options: Every thirty minutes, starting at six.
explain: Hỏi What time → "Every thirty minutes, starting at six". Bẫy: "main entrance" trả lời Where; "flight" chỉ liên tưởng airport.

prompt: How many people signed up for the workshop?
explain: Hỏi How many → con số "Over forty". Bẫy: "Sign" lặp âm signed; "on Friday" trả lời When.

prompt: When is the report due?
options: Let me check with my manager.
explain: Trả lời gián tiếp "Let me check with my manager" (chưa biết, sẽ hỏi). Bẫy: lặp "report"; "To the regional director" trả lời Who/Where.

prompt: Which hotel are you staying at in Chicago?
options: The one near the convention center.
explain: Hỏi Which → "The one near the convention center". Bẫy: "three nights" trả lời How long; "stayed" lặp từ, sai thì.

prompt: Where can I find the replacement ink cartridges?
options: Try the cabinet next to the copier.
explain: Hỏi Where → "the cabinet next to the copier". Bẫy: "replace" lặp âm replacement nhưng nói về người.

prompt: Is the cafeteria open on weekends?
explain: Câu hỏi Yes/No trả lời gián tiếp "Only on Saturdays". Bẫy: "café" gần âm cafeteria; "Open" lặp từ nhưng là mệnh lệnh.

prompt: Should I print the handouts or just e-mail them?
explain: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → chọn một phương án "E-mailing them would save paper". Bẫy: "Yes" không trả lời câu A or B; "Twenty copies" trả lời How many.

prompt: I can't log in to the company network.
options: Did you try resetting your password?
explain: Nghe vấn đề không đăng nhập được → gợi ý "resetting your password". Bẫy: lặp "network", "log" nhưng sai nghĩa.

prompt: Who's going to replace Ms. Okafor when she retires?
options: At the end of the year.
explain: Trả lời gián tiếp "hasn't decided yet" (chưa biết ai). Bẫy: "end of the year" trả lời When; "tired" gần âm retires.

prompt: Aren't you attending the trade fair in Frankfurt?
options: I had to cancel because of a deadline.
explain: Câu phủ định → "I had to cancel" = không đi. Bẫy: "fair" đồng âm khác nghĩa (giá hợp lý); "exhibition hall" trả lời Where.

prompt: Would you mind covering my shift on Saturday?
options: Not at all—what time do you start?
explain: "Would you mind...?" → "Not at all" nghĩa là đồng ý giúp. Bẫy: "cover", "shifted" lặp từ nhưng khác nghĩa.

prompt: Why is the parking lot so empty today?
explain: Hỏi Why → lý do "It's a national holiday". Bẫy: "a hundred spaces" trả lời How many; "parked" lặp từ parking.

prompt: How long will the renovation take?
options: The contractor estimates about six weeks.
explain: Hỏi How long (thời gian) → "about six weeks". Bẫy: "very long" lặp từ long; "lobby area" trả lời Where.

prompt: What did you think of the new logo design?
options: I think it looks more modern.
explain: Hỏi ý kiến → "it looks more modern". Bẫy: "designer's name" trả lời Who; "design firm" trả lời Where.

prompt: Let's review the proposal once more before we submit it.
options: Good idea—I'll book a meeting room.
explain: Lời đề nghị → đồng ý "Good idea" và hành động tiếp. Bẫy: "proposed" gần âm; "was submitted" sai thì (chưa nộp).

prompt: Did you get a chance to call the bank?
options: Yes, they're sending the forms today.
explain: "Yes" kèm kết quả cuộc gọi "sending the forms today". Bẫy: "bank" đồng âm khác nghĩa (bờ sông); lặp "chance".

prompt: Where should I put these boxes?
options: Just leave them by the door.
explain: Hỏi Where → "by the door". Bẫy: "Since this morning" trả lời How long; "Yes" không dùng cho câu WH.

prompt: When did Mr. Russo join the company?
options: Shortly after I did, I believe.
explain: Hỏi When (quá khứ) → "Shortly after I did". Bẫy: "He'll join" lặp từ và sai thì; "legal department" trả lời Which/Where.

prompt: The deadline's been extended, hasn't it?
explain: Câu hỏi đuôi → "Yes, until next Friday". Bẫy: "extension", "extend" lặp âm nhưng sai nghĩa.

prompt: Do you want the window seat or the aisle seat?
explain: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → "I don't mind either way" (sao cũng được). Bẫy: "Have a seat" lặp từ; "Yes, I do" không trả lời A or B.

prompt: This invoice has the wrong amount on it.
explain: Phản hồi vấn đề hóa đơn sai → "I'll contact the accounting department". Bẫy: lặp "amount", "invoiced".

prompt: How often is the equipment inspected?
explain: Hỏi How often (tần suất) → "Twice a year". Bẫy: "By a safety officer" trả lời Who; "expensive" trả lời How much.

prompt: What's the fastest way to get to the convention center?
options: It's the biggest center in town.
Take the subway—it's only two stops.
explain: Hỏi cách đi nhanh nhất → "Take the subway". Bẫy: lặp "center"; "a thousand attendees" trả lời How many.

prompt: Can you help me set up the projector?
explain: Lời nhờ → "Sure, give me one minute". Bẫy: "project" gần âm projector; "set" lặp từ nhưng sai ngữ cảnh.

prompt: Haven't the new employees received their ID badges yet?
options: The badge reader at the door.
They should get them this afternoon.
explain: Câu phủ định → "should get them this afternoon" = chưa nhận, chiều nay sẽ có. Bẫy: "employed" gần âm employees; lặp "badge".

prompt: Why did you move the meeting to the afternoon?
explain: Hỏi Why → lý do gián tiếp "The director's flight arrives late". Bẫy: "Meeting Room B" trả lời Where; "moved" lặp từ.

prompt: Who left this umbrella in the lobby?
explain: Hỏi Who → "It might be Daniel's". Bẫy: "raining" chỉ liên tưởng umbrella; "Left" đồng âm (rẽ trái).

prompt: Is there a discount for bulk orders?
explain: Câu Yes/No trả lời gián tiếp "Only for orders over 500 units". Bẫy: "count" gần âm discount; "Order" lặp từ.

prompt: How about hiring a temporary assistant for the busy season?
options: I'll ask HR if we have the budget.
explain: Lời đề nghị → phản hồi gián tiếp "I'll ask HR if we have the budget". Bẫy: "three months" trả lời How long; lặp "season".

prompt: When does the store close tonight?
options: At nine, the same as usual.
explain: Hỏi When → "At nine". Bẫy: "Close" lặp từ nhưng là mệnh lệnh; "Near the train station" trả lời Where.

prompt: The client wants to move the deadline up by a week.
options: That won't give us much time.
explain: Phản hồi tin hạn chót bị đẩy sớm → "That won't give us much time". Bẫy: lặp "move", "weekly" nhưng sai nghĩa.

prompt: Are you taking the bus or driving to the conference?
options: My colleague is giving me a ride.
explain: Câu lựa chọn trả lời phương án thứ ba "My colleague is giving me a ride". Bẫy: lặp "conference"; "Yes" không hợp câu A or B.

prompt: How much does it cost to rent the ballroom?
options: The price list is on our website.
explain: Hỏi giá → trả lời gián tiếp "The price list is on our website". Bẫy: "200 guests" trả lời How many; lặp "room".

prompt: Where did you put the signed agreements?
options: They're in the top drawer of my desk.
explain: Hỏi Where → "in the top drawer of my desk". Bẫy: "agreed", "Sign" lặp âm; "Yes" không dùng cho câu WH.

prompt: What's on the agenda for tomorrow's meeting?
options: Mainly the budget for next year.
explain: Hỏi What (nội dung) → "Mainly the budget". Bẫy: "Tomorrow at ten" trả lời When; "Yes" không dùng cho câu WH.

prompt: Will the software update affect our files?
options: The IT team said everything will be backed up.
explain: Trả lời gián tiếp "everything will be backed up" (dữ liệu an toàn). Bẫy: lặp "software"; "up to date" gần âm update.

prompt: Why don't you take the afternoon off?
explain: "Why don't you..." là lời gợi ý → "Thanks, I think I will". Bẫy: "Because" hiểu nhầm là hỏi lý do; lặp "afternoon".

prompt: You're presenting at the board meeting, aren't you?
options: Actually, Ms. Lee is doing it instead.
explain: Câu hỏi đuôi → trả lời gián tiếp "Ms. Lee is doing it instead" = không phải tôi. Bẫy: "present" đồng âm (món quà); lặp "board".
